articles.title: Budget tablet arrives with 11-inch display, 8,300mAh battery and microSD expansion
articles.description: Oscal has introduced the Bolt 2, an 11-inch Android 16 tablet powered by the Unisoc T7250 processor. It features a 90Hz IPS display, up to 8GB of RAM, 128GB of storage, 4G LTE connectivity and an 8,300mAh battery.

articles.title: Physicists use laser light to unlock a crystal's hidden electrical powers
articles.description: Scientists have discovered how to use flashes of laser light to organize tiny electrical regions inside a crystal, solving a decades-old mystery about how the material behaves. The laser-induced alignment lasts just a trillionth of a second, but the breakthrough could open the door to new ways of processing and storing information.
